composer.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter for a new line · Esc stops the answer · ↑ edits your last message · drop or paste files to attach · / for commands and prompts

composer.concurrencyLimit: {agent} is already answering {limit} chats. Wait for one to finish, or open it in the chat list.

composer.usage: This chat has used {tokens, number} tokens so far, the context size after its last answer.
composer.usageNone: No answer yet to measure token usage from.
composer.undoDone: Removed the last exchange. Send a new message to continue from before it.

refusal.config: This changes the agent’s own configuration — use the agent’s settings in Helena instead.
refusal.outside: This isn’t something the chat can do.

interrupted.continuePrompt: Please continue where you were interrupted.

where.listenLocal: Speech recognition: Whisper on this machine
where.listenBrowser: Speech recognition: the browser (Chrome and Safari send the recording to Google or Apple)
where.speakNone: Answers are not read aloud (Local only)

problems.insecureTitle: The microphone needs a secure connection
problems.insecure: Browsers only lend the microphone over HTTPS, and Helena runs over http here. Until HTTPS arrives: open {flag} in Chrome, enter {origin}, choose “Enabled” and restart Chrome. Safari and Firefox: only with HTTPS.
problems.flagCopied: Address copied – paste it into Chrome's address bar.
problems.localOnlyDownTitle: Local transcription is unavailable right now
problems.localOnlyDown: Transcription is set to “Local only”: your voice does not leave this machine, so the browser does not step in. Try again shortly or check Administrator → Local AI.
problems.unsupported: Turn on “Transcription (dictation)” under Administrator → Local AI – Whisper on this machine then writes along, in any browser.
problems.blocked: The browser did not allow the microphone. Allow it in the site settings (the icon at the left of the address bar).
problems.failed: The microphone could not be started.
problems.voiceFailed: The local voice failed. The answer is in the chat; where allowed, the browser reads on.
problems.nothingHeard: Nothing understood – was the microphone on?
problems.limit: Stopped after {seconds} seconds – the longest a dictation can be.
problems.echo: On loudspeakers, interrupt me with “Interrupt” from now on. With headphones or the local voice, speaking works too.
